text: Discussing QuALITY, the authors note that Khan et al. saw no improvement with more debate rounds, suggesting no advantage to pointing out the opponent's flaws. They add that Khan et al.'s Fig. 15 suggests quote verification, not argumentation, dominates judge accuracy, and that such a tool may be unrealistic for human oversight of stronger AI.
title: Quote verification, not argumentation, appears to dominate judge accuracy in Khan et al.'s QuALITY debates, and such a tool may be unrealistic
